correctness.rationale: Necessary-and-sufficient row recursion enumerates 42 distinct ASMs; independent monotone-triangle recursion produces the identical 42 signed matrices. All 19,683 reduced frequencies were evaluated as exact cube-root count triples and independently by nine-dimensional Eisenstein DFT; both complete squared-norm histograms agree across 53 levels and Parseval total 826686. Exactly 734 reduced zero characters have 2187 lifts each, giving full nullity 1605258 and rank 41441463. The least positive squared norm 3 is attained by q=(2,2,0,0,1,0,0,0,0), phase counts (13,15,14). All 32 one-coordinate and 480 two-coordinate ambient characters checked, with precisely 16 weight-two zeros of the stated central adjacent-pair shape. Full finite verification, not inference from samples.

value.rationale: Reducing signed ASM entries modulo three is a faithful canonical small finite-field embedding, and size four is the first size with total ASM count divisible by three. The exact 734/19683 loss of recoverable quotient characters, sharp nonzero spectral gap sqrt(3), and complete 16-character first-cancellation geometry are mathematically natural finite invariants of this six-vertex family, not arbitrary slices or re-computation of the known enumeration 42. They give a reproducible baseline for character sums at larger orders; no downstream theorem is claimed.
